name: Gonzo's Quest

features.name: Avalanche
features.description: Winning symbols explode and new ones fall – one of the first cascade mechanics in online slots.

features.name: Free Falls
features.description: Free spins where the avalanche multiplier goes up to 15x.

review:
The explorer who made cascading reels popular, long before tumble slots were everywhere. Each avalanche in a row raises the multiplier – up to 5x in the base game and 15x in Free Falls – so long chains are where the real wins come from.

Free Falls trigger on three gold symbols on the first three reels and can retrigger. Medium volatility makes it easy-going for long demo sessions. The 95.97% RTP is lower than many modern games. A great way to understand cascade multipliers.
